summary: The retained execution (receipt 430d7ba602ed4666bdfe63a96c71e2fc, witness index 1) confirms the first finding: with RestoreCommittedLogs=true and no snapshot the restarted node comes back with zero servers, logs 'no known peers, aborting election' and never campaigns again, while both controls keep the configuration and re-elect; the interpretation is now recorded as violated/asserted with that receipt and witness. I then pursued the registered gap with a second, two-voter probe: after a snapshot and a committed AddVoter C, restarting the leader (with the change no longer the newest log entry) makes it adopt the stale snapshot configuration (2 servers though its peer and its own log say 3), and a subsequent successful AddVoter E then silently drops voter C cluster-wide, whereas the RestoreCommittedLogs=false control keeps C and ends with 4 members. Source chain added (appendConfigurationEntry computing the next configuration from the stale base, configuration.go nextConfiguration, configuration-change admission gate); the gap is answered as partial progress pending this experiment's retained receipt.
